🪙 CoinFlip

The simplest game of chance: a coin is flipped and you predict which face lands up. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Choose your prediction: Heads or Tails.
  2. Click to flip the coin.
  3. If your prediction matches the result, you win.
  4. Track your win/loss streak across multiple flips.
  5. There's no skill involved — it's pure probability.
